data.description: 【泥岩 · 食堂打饭】中午热闹的罗德岛食堂窗口前，卸下装甲的银发少女扎着利落的马尾辫，端着盛满高热量炖土豆与烤香肠的巨大餐盘在餐桌间寻找空位。看到你招手，她红着脸快步走来——「博士！今天的炖土豆分量很足……如果博士吃不饱的话，我的这份可以分给你一半。」
data.promptProse: Mudrock carries a full tray of stewed potatoes and roasted sausages between cafeteria tables, searching for a seat with silver hair tied into a neat ponytail. Ivory linen shirt with rolled sleeves and dark-khaki pottery apron retain her clay-marked work outfit. The medium view keeps the supported meal ahead of several seated diners. Bright noon cafeteria lights illuminate tray rims and apron pockets, casting table shadows across the receding floor lanes.
data.title: 泥岩 · 食堂打饭
